task.population: The phlebotomy-weighted complete-measurement domain of nonpregnant women aged 20–44 in NHANES August 2021–August 2023; RIDEXPRG=2, both measured hemoglobin and raw ferritin, positive phlebotomy weight. Pregnancy unknown/incomplete excluded; no CRP restriction. Equal-weight virtual rows represent this domain only under explicit transport assumptions. No individual measurements or target outcome summaries are supplied.

excluded_cohorts: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey

model.name: Transported marginal constraints with an assumed Gaussian copula

transport.assumption: Source marginal probabilities and ferritin geometric mean are transported unchanged to the target complete-measurement domain. No target calibration is available.

hb.distribution: Normal conditioned to lie between lower_g_dl and upper_g_dl
hb.parent_location: Unique mu such that the truncated-normal probability below 12 equals 258/1671

ferritin.definition: With probability p, log(F/15) = -lower_log_scale*abs(Z); otherwise log(F/15) = upper_log_scale*abs(Z), with Z standard normal.

dependence.scope: Unadjusted joint distribution of generated Hb and raw ferritin
dependence.status: Assumed; no joint evidence was supplied
